notes: Seventeen source and twenty-two target tokens each partitioned once.

Both articles on הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת are unrepresented and this goes to the demonstrative, since a morpheme present in the phrase licenses the ASV's one determiner — rule 41's rider, matching rule 29's הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה → these cities.
אֶל־חִנָּם is split rather than fused: the ASV spends in on the preposition and vain on the adverb, so each morpheme has a rendering of its own and rule 30's condition is unmet.
The purpose לְ takes the complementizer that while the infinitive keeps I would do, per rule 52.
